turns.text: I kept most of the logic in the checkout controller because it's only being used by checkout right now.

turns.text: Okay, that makes sense. But could we move the validation into a service?

turns.text: We could. Are you thinking we might reuse it somewhere else?

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: What about it?

turns.speaker: James
turns.text: We don't necessarily need to change the response in this PR.

turns.text: Yeah, that's probably better. We can extract the validation logic now and keep the error response as it is.

turns.text: I agree. That keeps the PR focused.

turns.text: Sounds good. So David will extract the validation logic, and we'll keep the current error response for now.
